description: This file defines the Layer class for Leaflet, a JavaScript library for interactive maps. It includes class inheritance, methods for adding/removing layers, and map interaction logic.

classes.name: Layer
classes.description: A base class for all Leaflet layers, inheriting from Evented, providing methods for layer management and interaction with the map.

methods.name: addTo
methods.description: Adds the layer to a specified map or layer group.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the layer from the current map.

methods.name: removeFrom
methods.description: Removes the layer from a specified map.

methods.name: getPane
methods.description: Returns the HTML element representing the layer's pane.

methods.name: addInteractiveTarget
methods.description: Adds an interactive target element to the map.

methods.name: removeInteractiveTarget
methods.description: Removes an interactive target element from the map.

methods.name: getAttribution
methods.description: Returns the attribution string for the layer.

methods.name: _layerAdd
methods.description: Internal method called when the layer is added to a map, sets up event listeners and attribution.
